info.title: YINYU CTF Platform Open API
info.description: YINYU CTF Platform external API contract

post.description: Queues deployment of a released topology for one team or automation owner.

get.description: Returns the aggregated runtime, shard, network, and asset state.

delete.description: Queues cleanup of all runtime shards, assets, routes, captures, and access grants.

post.description: Queues a controlled cleanup and redeployment using the runtime release and optional overlays.

get.description: Returns cursor-paginated lifecycle and deployment events for troubleshooting and audit.

post.description: Queues creation of a short-lived, single-download player access configuration.

get.description: Consumes the one-time download token and returns the WireGuard configuration file.

delete.description: Queues revocation and cleanup of an existing runtime access grant.

get.description: Returns the topology schema and feature capabilities supported by this platform version.

post.description: Queues creation of a reusable TeamLab topology draft.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of topologies visible to the current API token owner.
Returns the complete editable topology definition.

put.description: Queues replacement of the editable topology definition.

delete.description: Queues deletion of a topology that is no longer in use.

post.description: Validates topology structure, addressing, connectivity, assets, and deployment constraints without publishing it.
Validates and queues creation of an immutable topology release for runtime deployment.

get.description: Returns immutable releases for a topology using cursor pagination.
Returns one immutable topology release and its compiled definition.

post.description: Builds a deployment plan for the release without creating runtime resources.

get.description: Returns cursor-paginated, runtime-scoped flow metadata collected from the TeamLab data plane.
Returns end-to-end traffic path correlations across participating assets and network segments.
Returns the ordered hops and evidence for one correlated traffic path.

post.description: Queues a bounded packet capture for selected runtime shards or network segments.

get.description: Returns capture scope, limits, progress, artifact state, and retention metadata.

post.description: Queues an early stop and finalization of a running packet capture.

get.description: Streams the finalized runtime capture archive.
